subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: After the Android chronology fix and native runtime proof, should OpenClaw adopt permanent native inline question summaries together with Control UI composer takeover as the supported cross-surface interaction model?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the primary input experience across four user-facing clients, and the protected maintainer label signals that final UX acceptance should not be inferred solely from tests and screenshots.

options.title: Adopt the parity model
options.body: Merge after the ordering repair, changelog cleanup, and redacted native runtime evidence confirm the intended web and native interaction model.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep persistence and recovery improvements but defer composer takeover or any client-specific interaction changes that do not receive explicit product approval.

recommendation.title: Adopt the parity model
recommendation.body: Merge after the ordering repair, changelog cleanup, and redacted native runtime evidence confirm the intended web and native interaction model.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history and PR rationale show direct ownership of the proposed cross-surface behavior.
